info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin O Auth2 API
info.description: Exposes super-user OAuth2 client management endpoints for Matomo. This API lists configured scopes and lets administrators create, inspect, update, rotate, activate, and delete OAuth2 clients.

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.

request.description: Lists all OAuth2 clients configured in Matomo (super users only).

response.name:
OAuth2 clients ordered by most recently updated first.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.
